summary: Eva Live Inc filed an 8-K reporting governance and officer compensation events. The company issued CEO David Boulette 200,000 shares of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock on September 25, 2026 under an August 17 employment agreement, and filed Amended and Restated Articles with Nevada on September 23, 2026, declassifying the board for annual elections, requiring 66.67% shareholder approval to remove directors for cause only, and updating indemnification. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or premium is stated; the board-entrenchment provisions may delay control changes. Watch for dilution from the preferred issuance and any future control contest.
